description:
This protocol performs a custom cherrypicked PCR/qPRC prep. It requires a CSV input for the source and destination wells of the samples. It will automatically add mastermix based on the number of samples inputted to the PCR plate sequentially (A1-12 then B1-12, etc...).


Opentrons Temperature Module
P20 single-channel GEN2 electronic pipette
Opentrons 20ul filter tiprack
Corning 96-Well Nonbinding Surface Microplates (3641)
NEST 0.1 mL 96-Well PCR Plate, Full Skirt
Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with Generic 2 mL Screwcap
Opentrons 96 Well Aluminum Block with Generic PCR Strip 200 µL



Deck Setup
 Opentrons 20ul filter tiprack (Slot 1, Slot 4, Slot 7)
 Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with Generic 2 mL Screwcap (Slot 2, Mastermix in well A6)
 Opentrons Temperature Module (Slot 3)
 96 well PCR Strip (Aluminum Block) OR 96 well NEST 100uL PCR Plate (Slot 3 on Temperature Module)
* Corning 96-Well Nonbinding Surface Microplates OR Opentrons 24-slot Tube Rack (Slot 5, Slot 6, Slot 8, Slot 11)

labware.name: Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 20 µL on 1
Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with Generic 2 mL Screwcap on 2
Applied Biosystems 96 Well Plate 100 µL on Temperature Module GEN2 on 3
Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 20 µL on 4
Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 20 µL on 7

workflow.text: Setting temperature to 4C on the Temperature Module
